channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities highlight a critical threat environment characterized by widespread unauthenticated remote code execution and memory corruption flaws, with Microsoft Windows, Azure cloud services, and SQL Server representing the most heavily impacted assets. High-severity issues in foundational networking protocols such as DNS, DHCP, and SMB, combined with prevalent buffer overflows and deserialization attacks in .NET applications, create immediate opportunities for system compromise and lateral movement across enterprise networks. Concurrently, substantial risks affect embedded and operational technology sectors, including Zephyr-based IoT devices and industrial controllers, while mobile security faces degradation due to Bluetooth and Wi-Fi driver defects.
